  "pros": [
    "Intuitive drag-and-drop interface made website creation easy.",
    "Professional-looking templates helped achieve a polished business site.",
    "All-in-one platform for hosting and site management was convenient."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Lack of advanced features specific to the veterinary industry.",
    "Customer support could be slow to resolve more complex issues.",
    "Difficulty with SEO for local search visibility."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Office Manager found Wix to be a highly accessible tool for quickly establishing a professional online presence for their small veterinary practice. While appreciating its ease of use and design capabilities, they likely encountered some limitations regarding industry-specific functionalities or more advanced customization. Despite minor frustrations with support and specialized needs, the platform served its primary purpose effectively for over two years."
